items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I was playing this place here with Lester Nelson and Harry Schuyl was playing.

ctx.x: Okay, we can turn the machine off for a second. Good.
Get it. I was playing this place here with Lester Nelson and Harry Schuyl was playing. I was playing the drum. Yeah. I see.

We can turn it off. Let Mrs. Guterres tell you about her son who plays on guitar, too. Oh, yeah. I just wanted to tell you that he plays the guitar and writes music. He's very talented. What kind of music does he write? I don't know whether...is it rock and roll sound? Well, yeah, it's a rock and roll. I don't know. But at the worst night, the music player...
